# SLO policy — checkout-api

| SLO | Objective (30d) | SLI | Error budget |
|---|---|---|---|
| Availability | 99.5% | non-5xx responses / all responses (user routes only) | 0.5% ≈ 3 h 36 min of full outage |
| Latency | 99% | responses < 300 ms / all responses | 1% of requests may be slower |

Probe and metrics endpoints are excluded from the SLI (they are not user journeys). 4xx responses are the client's
fault and do not burn budget.

## Alerting (generated by `scripts/generate_slo_rules.py`)

| Severity | Burn rate | Long window | Short window | Budget consumed when it fires |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| page | 14.4x | 1h | 5m | 2% in 1 hour |
| page | 6x | 6h | 30m | 5% in 6 hours |
| ticket | 3x | 1d | 2h | 10% in 1 day |
| ticket | 1x | 3d | 6h | 10% in 3 days |

The short window makes alerts reset quickly once the problem is fixed; the long window prevents paging on blips.

## Error budget policy
- **> 50% budget left:** ship freely; canaries run the standard 25/50/75% schedule.
- **< 50% left:** prod canaries use the slow schedule only; one release per day.
- **< 25% left:** feature releases pause; only reliability fixes and rollbacks ship.
- **Exhausted:** release freeze until the 30-day window recovers; mandatory postmortem for the largest contributor.
- Any single incident burning > 2% of the monthly budget gets a blameless postmortem.
